purpose: Verify, without constructing or interacting with an original Causal-Gymnasium world, that the pinned upstream two-stage binary DTR API can be represented by the existing Yggdrasil NativeEpisodeExperience public episode interface. This is a mechanical mapping and negative-control test, not source first-use or scientific evaluation.

native_source.expected_interface: NativeEpisodeExperience.observe(identifier, views, row); propose(view, first=None, next_state=None); checkpoint/restore

frozen_mapping.paired_views: ((S1,0),(S1,1)); coordinate 0 retains S1 and coordinate 1 is the public stage marker
frozen_mapping.native_row: exact keys s1,x1,s2,x2,y; s1 is retained in paired_views; x1,s2,x2,y enter the native ordered event
frozen_mapping.update_timing: Only after terminal Y is observed; no stage-0 partial episode update

required_checks: Verify all 13 pinned upstream source Git blob identities and import exact DTRSCM/DTRPCH classes without instantiating either.
Verify DTRPCH constructor signature has no task argument and Task() defaults to ctf_do.
Verify the do-only PCH permission contract allows do and denies see and ctf_do, without a DTR instance.
Static-check that DTRPCH.do policy callbacks receive S1 then S1,X1,S2 and do not pass U; confirm see can pass U and therefore is forbidden.
Verify the do/step info payload is excluded from all learner inputs.
Run the frozen paired-view mapping against synthetic binary fixtures through the exact NativeEpisodeExperience.observe/propose/checkpoint/restore implementation.

Verify projection selects stable S1 coordinate, action proposals are binary, predictions survive cold restore, malformed/missing/extra fields fail closed, and no state changes occur on invalid updates.
Write one deterministic result with explicit zero source interaction counts.
stop_conditions: Any source hash mismatch or native interface drift.
Any path that instantiates DTRSCM/DTRPCH, calls reset/see/do/ctf_do/step, or consumes a source cohort.
Any attempt to pass upstream info, hidden U, graph, evaluator fields, or future outcome into the learner.
Any failure of the frozen paired-view mapping or cold restore.
